# Tree grid rows announce every parent row as collapsed

## Context

Found while restyling grouped rows in Neo Pro (neomjs/neo-pro#23, which keys an expanded group's styling on `aria-expanded`). In the Pro Workstation's grouped matrix, the `healthy` group shows its eight fleets and draws the expanded chevron, yet its row element renders `aria-expanded="false"`. Measured on `dev` `b0e5fceb91` with a Playwright locator on `.neo-grid-row[aria-rowindex="2"]`.

## The Problem

`Neo.grid.Row#createVdom` (`src/grid/Row.mjs:445-449`) stamps a tree grid's non-leaf row with `aria-expanded = record.expanded || false`. But `Neo.data.TreeModel` declares no `expanded` field. Its expansion state is `collapsed` (`src/data/TreeModel.mjs:33`), and `TreeStore` reads and writes that field (`src/data/TreeStore.mjs` `collapse()` / `expand()` / `expandAll()`). The attribute is therefore `false` on every parent row, whatever its state.

Consequences:

- Screen readers announce every expanded branch as collapsed (WAI-ARIA treegrid).
- No selector can tell an expanded row from a collapsed one, although the tree cell's own toggle knows (`is-expanded` in `src/grid/column/component/Tree.mjs#updateIconCls`).

It has been like this since #9408 (TreeGrid accessibility). No test reads the attribute.

## The Fix

`src/grid/Row.mjs`: `vdom['aria-expanded'] = record.collapsed === false`. `TreeStore` defaults an unset `collapsed` to `true` on ingest, so `=== false` matches its own expanded test (`node.collapsed === false`, `src/data/TreeStore.mjs:356`).

Unit test: a tree-grid row renders `aria-expanded` true for an expanded parent, false for a collapsed one, and no attribute for a leaf. It is red on `dev` for the expanded case.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: An expanded parent row renders `aria-expanded="true"` and a collapsed one `"false"`; a leaf renders none.
- [ ] AC-2: The new unit test fails on `dev` and passes at the head; the `grid` unit folder stays green.

## Out of Scope

- The tree cell's toggle classes, which are already correct.
- Any styling. Consumers such as neomjs/neo-pro#23 key on the corrected attribute.

## Related

#9408 (TreeGrid accessibility, where the line comes from), #9404 (tree grid epic), neomjs/neo-pro#23 (consumer).

Sweeps: latest 20 open engine issues plus an all-state search ("aria-expanded tree grid": #9404, #9412, #9413, #18439, none on this attribute), the A2A in-flight sweep (no grid-ARIA claim), and my own assignments, at 2026-11-07T17:0xZ. No equivalent found.
